findings.title: Total loss of the monitoring/alerting path has no independent dead-man's-switch receiver
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402 (corrects the previous verified-fixed call): the mechanism is complete — Watchdog rule + dedicated watchdog receiver with a 5m repeat (alertmanager.tmpl.yml:87-100,147-152) and a fail-closed prod deploy guard (deploy-do.yml:856-863) — but the receiver is still NOT provisioned: docs/INCIDENT_RESPONSE.md:148-158 states ALERTMANAGER_WATCHDOG_WEBHOOK_URL is still unset and prod deploys fail closed until it is set, and the 2026-10-11 desk dry-run records 'Actual: none — the heartbeat stays on the box' (INCIDENT_TABLETOP_DRYRUN_2026-10-11.md, gap G1). No exercise artifact exists, so a total monitoring-path loss is still undetected off-box.

findings.title: No runtime detection or alerting for tenant-isolation (RLS) regressions
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: portal_rls_bypass_total/portal_rls_enforced_total are emitted from services/supabase.ts and alerted by MCTTenantScopeRegression and MCTRlsEnforcedShareCollapsed (prometheus.rules.yml:162-215), with promtool unit tests wired into CI via .github/actions/prometheus-rules (test.yml:52, validate.yml:50).

findings.title: Prometheus alert rules are not routed anywhere
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: prometheus.yml forwards to alertmanager:9093, the alertmanager service is defined with a healthcheck, and the routing tree sends critical/default/Watchdog to ntfy-backed receivers (alertmanager.tmpl.yml:55-152); RELEASE_GATE still lists a synthetic delivery as an operator exit condition, now covered by the alert-path-exercise workflow.

findings.title: No committed dashboards or SLO/error-budget definitions
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: infra/digitalocean/dashboards/mct-overview.json and docs/SLO.md exist; SLO.md now lists six objectives with PromQL and maps each to a live alert rule (MCTHighRequestErrorRate, MCTNotificationDeliveryFailureRateHigh, MCTWorkerTaskFailures/DeadLettered, MCTRlsEnforcedShareCollapsed) and documents the error-budget policy.

findings.title: Backup/restore is scheduled but not verified on the deployed branch
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the workflows and their notifiers exist on main and the staleness check (backup-staleness-check.yml) plus the worker heartbeat alert (MCTWorkerTaskFailures) now cover the gap independently; still partially fixed because no backup/restore run has ever succeeded (DR-P0-001) — the latest db-backup (2026-10-13) and db-restore-test (2026-10-12) runs are red and docs/RELEASE_GATE.md:69 keeps the exit condition open.

findings.title: Several Prometheus metrics are declared but not wired, limiting incident diagnosis
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the previously unwired metrics all have live call sites and the worker's task/queue/notification/stripe metrics are wired (apps/worker/src/metrics.ts, task-registry.ts); docs/MONITORING_AND_ALERTING.md and docs/SLO.md were reconciled to the wired set (OBS-P3-007).

findings.title: No alerting on audit-trail gaps or privileged (impersonation/admin) abuse
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: privileged abuse is now covered (portal_impersonation_events_total drives MCTImpersonationBurst and MCTImpersonationActivity, prometheus.rules.yml:102-130, with the admin impersonation review surface); the audit-trail-gap half is still absent — there is no metric or rule for audit-write failures, missing rows, or export gaps (grep of apps/api/src/lib/metrics.ts and prometheus.rules.yml finds none).

findings.title: No alerting when webhook dead-letters accumulate or payment reconciliation drifts
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: MCTWebhookDeadLettersAccumulating (prometheus.rules.yml:217-228, API+worker counters) and MCTStripeReconcileDrift (:360-368) exist; stripe-reconcile.ts:190-191 increments worker_stripe_reconcile_drift_total per drift kind (metrics.ts:205), and MCTWebhookDeliveryFailureRateHigh covers the sustained-failure case.

findings.title: `/health` publicly discloses provider configuration and Redis errors
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the public /health response is minimal and dependency detail lives on the token-gated /health/detail (apps/api/src/routes/health.ts; docs/MONITORING_AND_ALERTING.md:82-138 documents the split and the 404-without-token behavior).

findings.title: Availability detection lives inside the failed domain; no external dead-man's switch or alert delivery
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: off-box watchdog receiver + fail-closed prod guard + external ntfy delivery for backup/uptime failures exist; the same control set is re-assessed (unexercised) under OBS-P0-001/IR-P0-003. The detector now also includes an external uptime probe (external-uptime-probe.yml), see OBS-P2-016/OBS-P2-017.

findings.title: Most golden-signal and SLO metrics have no alert rules (latency, circuit breaker, auth failures, notification/webhook failures, worker jobs, queue depth)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the rules file now has 23 alerts covering latency (MCTHighRequestLatency), breaker state (MCTCircuitBreakerOpen), auth failures (MCTAuthFailureRateHigh), notification/webhook delivery (MCTNotificationDeliveryFailureRateHigh, MCTWebhookDeliveryFailureRateHigh, MCTNotificationEmailSkipped), worker jobs/DLQ (MCTWorkerTaskFailures, MCTWorkerTaskDeadLettered), queue depth/growth/disconnect (MCTWorkerQueueBacklog, BacklogGrowing, Disconnected), Redis degradation and Stripe drift.

findings.title: HTTP metric labels use the raw request path, creating unbounded Prometheus series cardinality
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: request-id.ts labels metrics with the matched Express route template (routeLabel: req.route.path + req.baseUrl) and collapses unmatched requests into one 'unmatched' bucket; commit d9911286.

findings.title: Web error tracking is silently disabled in production (code reads NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN; deploy provides SENTRY_DSN)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the web Sentry configs resolve the DSN with a fallback to SENTRY_DSN (sentry.server.config.ts / sentry.edge.config.ts / instrumentation-client.ts), the deploy forwards both NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN and SENTRY_DSN (deploy-do.yml:740) and the build passes the public DSN; commit d9911286.

findings.title: Alerting configuration is not validated in CI and the deploy health gate ignores Prometheus/Alertmanager
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: promtool check rules + unit tests run in CI through .github/actions/prometheus-rules (test.yml:48-52, validate.yml:47-50); the deploy gate asserts every healthchecked service including prometheus and alertmanager (deploy-do.yml:1056-1085) and alertmanager has a healthcheck.

findings.title: Empty METRICS_TOKEN has no deploy guard and is documented as optional; it breaks the API scrape and fires a false service-down alert
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: deploy-do.yml:818-834 fails a prod deploy when METRICS_TOKEN is empty (dev warns), checks before writing the credentials file, and the docs/matrix now describe the token as required for the scrape; commit e6711ee7.

findings.title: Alert delivery and the dead-man's switch are configured but never exercised end-to-end; no monitoring-of-monitoring rules
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the exercise tooling is complete (alert-path-exercise.yml monthly + dispatch, scripts/exercise-alert-path.sh, docs/ALERT_PATH_EXERCISE.md) but has never run (0 runs in the public API; the evidence table still says 'none recorded yet') and the manual missed-heartbeat drill is still blocked on the unset watchdog URL. The monitoring-of-monitoring half also remains: no rule on prometheus_rule_evaluation_failures_total, alertmanager_notifications_failed_total, or a Prometheus self-liveness job (MCTServiceDown only covers mct-api|mct-worker, prometheus.rules.yml:11-13).

findings.title: Container logs are not persisted off-box and are destroyed by the deploy's `compose down`
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the deploy now snapshots the stack's logs (gzipped, last 7 kept) before the rolling recreate (deploy-do.yml:952-962) and no longer runs `compose down` on the success path, so deploy-destroyed logs are recoverable on-box. Still partially fixed: there is no off-box log shipping — docs/MONITORING_AND_ALERTING.md still lists central forwarding as future, so a droplet loss loses all logs.

findings.title: No repository evidence of external uptime checks for platform endpoints; an edge/proxy failure is undetected in-stack
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: external-uptime-probe.yml runs hourly from outside the droplet against scripts/uptime/probe-targets.json with status/latency budgets and fail-loud ntfy/Slack notification (eeb8b3ce); smoke-check.yml additionally exercises login + an authenticated read every 30 minutes (runs green on 2026-10-13). Residual (target noise/docs) is split into the new OBS-P2-017.

findings.title: Incident runbooks/tabletop evidence is partial
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the broken references are fixed — docs/INCIDENT_TABLETOP_SCENARIOS.md, docs/INCIDENT_TABLETOP_DRYRUN_2026-10-11.md and docs/runbooks/tabletop-exercise-planner.md exist, and INCIDENT_RESPONSE.md:148-168 now states Alertmanager is deployed and IR-P0-003 is partially fixed. Still partial: no live/human tabletop has been facilitated (the dry-run is desk-only with the reviewer placeholder), every PLATFORM_FAILURE_RUNBOOKS drill row is still `_pending_`, and the rota is unassigned.

findings.title: Monitoring doc and health endpoint disagree on check semantics; Redis severity undocumented in alerts
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/MONITORING_AND_ALERTING.md:82-138 now documents /health vs token-gated /health/detail, the provider checks, the Redis-is-degradation-never-outage semantics with the exact alert rules, and the worker's 503-on-queue-loss behavior — matching the code.

findings.title: `/metrics` is fully public when `METRICS_TOKEN` is unset
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the API returns 404 without a configured+presented bearer token (routes/health.ts, app.ts), the worker /metrics gate fails closed (health-server.ts:46-58) and Caddy also 404s the path.

findings.title: API/worker Sentry release markers are not delivered (no SENTRY_RELEASE/GIT_SHA)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the deploy sets SENTRY_RELEASE from the deployed ref (deploy-do.yml:666,770) and passes it into the api/worker containers (docker-compose.yml:93-95,172,252), where Sentry reads env.SENTRY_RELEASE with a GIT_SHA fallback; commit 10d2d172.

findings.title: Alertmanager secret provisioning gaps: matrix omits ALERTMANAGER_*; awk renderer breaks on '&' or backslash in values
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: the renderer was replaced with infra/digitalocean/render-alertmanager.awk (index/substr substitution + YAML escaping, no gsub metacharacters), it is bind-mounted and copied by the deploy, and the ALERTMANAGER_*/NTFY_ALERTS_* names are documented in docs/GITHUB_SECRETS_AND_VARIABLES_MATRIX.md:117-126,161-175.

findings.title: Metrics rate limiter leaves almost no headroom for the 15s scrape (max 5/min vs 4/min)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: rateLimitMetrics now allows 12/min (3x the 15s scrape rate) and still skips loopback (apps/api/src/middleware/rate-limit.ts:165-179).

findings.title: SLO and monitoring docs drift from implemented metrics and alert rules
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/SLO.md now maps every objective to a real rule and documents the worker metrics/queue alerts; docs/MONITORING_AND_ALERTING.md's metric table matches the wired set and documents the new uptime/smoke checks, the backup staleness signal and the Sentry release markers (commit 10d2d172).

findings.title: External uptime probe is permanently red on api.mainecybertech.com while the API answers on app.mainecybertech.com/api, and the docs disagree on why
findings.note: new at 7dd0402: external-uptime-probe.yml has failed on every hourly run since landing (38377276117, 38440530676, 38481070890 on 2026-10-13), each firing a high-priority ntfy notification, because the target api.mainecybertech.com/health returns 404. Live check 2026-10-14: api.mainecybertech.com/health, / and /api/v1/auth/sign-in all return 404 ('Cannot GET'), while app.mainecybertech.com/api/v1/auth/sign-in returns 400 (the API's validation response) and app.mainecybertech.com/login returns 200 — i.e. the prod API is serving through the web host, not the documented API host. Two docs give contradictory causes: scripts/uptime/probe-targets.json:9-11 and docs/MONITORING_AND_ALERTING.md:184-187 blame a 'legacy AWS ALB/ECS deployment', while docs/PRODUCTION_VS_TESTING_DOMAINS.md:4-6 explicitly states there is no ALB/ECS runtime and both zones use the droplet topology. Until the target or the docs are reconciled, the highest-severity external detector is in permanent alarm, the alert channel is desensitised, and the prod deploy health gate (deploy-do.yml:1144 curls https://$API_DOMAIN/health) would fail for the same reason.
